name: بوابة العلم
purpose: Unified entry point connecting Quran, Sunnah, Tafsir, Sirah, Fiqh and the encyclopedia's educational and research tools without conflating source identity, authenticity, or rights.
principles: Every displayed claim carries source identity and verification state.
Quran text remains separate from translations, tafsir, reflections and commentary.
Hadith existence in a book is separate from hadith grading.
Copyrighted editions are linked or API-served only under compatible terms; public-domain and explicitly free/waqf material may be acquired with provenance.
No silent inference when a source, legal status or scholarly judgment is unresolved.

quran.tafsir: Quran Foundation Content API / local licensed corpus when available
quran.reflections: Quran Foundation Quran Reflect resources when configured
quran.relatedVerses: study layer; source-linked, never presented as canonical text
quran.offlineSync: Quran Foundation resource sync when credentials are configured

media.video: Rights-aware external media link or licensed artifact
media.ocr: Processing pipeline for openly licensed/public-domain scans
